newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 30.905 million bushels wheat, 19.755 million bushels corn and no barley inspected in the week to Aug 22 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
WHEAT: Lakes to South Africa 655; Venezuela 420.
Gulf to Barbados 55; China 2,021; Colombia 845; Egypt 7,786; Grenada 135; Italy 441; South Korea 2,006; Mexico 1,442; Morocco 1,157; Panama 274; Venezuela 596; Zaire 308.
WHEAT: Pacific to Taiwan 508; Egypt 2,058; Japan 1,540; South Korea 256; Pakistan 772; Peru 950; Philippines 739; Singapore 212; Tanzania 793; Thailand 526; Yemen 2,314.
CORN: Gulf to Taiwan 4,464; Colombia 512; Costa Rica 794; Dominican Republic 396; Grenada 53; Japan 4,990; Jordan 1,950; South Korea 3,838; Venezuela 1,852.
